lineage.description: Flood hazard zones were classified by the National Directorate of Water Resource Management through direct observational hydrological data and anecdotal information collected as part of the national hydrological forecasting strategy. The resulting classified hazard zones represent deterministic flood-prone areas identified through monitoring and early warning protocols.
